proposition: A PG owner's day is a side-scrolling gauntlet of unpaid rent, slammed doors and leaking taps until he keys in the one cheat code that makes him untouchable: install the RentOK app.

board.style_line: Original 16-bit side-scrolling pixel-art platformer, 9:16 portrait, chunky black-outlined sprites, flat pale-cream sky, ground of blue #0038FF pixel bricks, cyan #03FFF1 accents, crisp square pixels with no blur, camera locked side-on at sprite height, top eighth of frame kept as an empty dark band for a HUD.
board.negative_line: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no red-capped plumber, no mushrooms, no question-mark blocks, no turtles or any existing game character or asset, no photoreal elements, no faces of real people, no dialogue.

identity_anchors.owner: a pixel-art PG owner sprite: stocky man, thick black moustache, round black spectacles, mustard-yellow kurta over grey trousers, brown sandals, a ring of iron keys bouncing on his belt, black outline, 16-bit proportions with a head one third of his height
identity_anchors.owner_powered: the same PG owner sprite after the power-up: kurta now blue #0038FF, a one-pixel cyan #03FFF1 glow outline around his whole body, his right forearm replaced by a chunky cyan pixel arm-cannon with a round barrel that fires small cyan check-mark bolts
identity_anchors.rentok_phone: a pixel smartphone item, rounded black body, screen lit solid blue #0038FF with a soft cyan #03FFF1 sparkle around it (the RentOK wordmark is composited onto the screen by code, never generated)
identity_anchors.world: a 2D platformer level: blue #0038FF brick ground filling the bottom third, pale-cream flat sky, obstacles as black-outlined pixel sprites standing on the ground, the owner always travelling left to right

hero_frame.description: The powered owner at the top of a tall cyan flagpole, one hand on the pole, the other holding the glowing phone high; behind him a three-storey pixel PG building with every window lit warm yellow and a small cyan check-mark floating over each window; on the blue ground below, five small grey heaps where the obstacles used to be. Every room paid, verified and sorted, read in one glance with no copy.

audio.music_bed: Original 8-bit chiptune platformer loop, about 140 bpm, bright square-wave lead over a bouncing bass; it dims to a single low pulse in beat 4, stops dead for the cheat-code entry in beat 5, returns at double tempo on the transformation, plays a level-clear fanfare in beat 8 and resolves to a two-note sting on the wordmark at the close. Fully original composition, no quotation of any existing game theme.

beats.title: Mid-jump over verification
beats.feeling: Dropped straight into the game: the small thrill of a jump you are not sure will clear.
beats.framing: Side-on platformer view. The owner sprite is mid-air at centre frame, arcing left to right over a grey spiked block built from a stack of pixel ID cards with a red pixel padlock on the front. Blue brick ground along the bottom third, pale sky, the dark HUD band empty at the top. Three small cyan coins hang in the air ahead to the right. The camera scrolls right with him.
beats.first_frame: The owner at the very apex of his jump, knees tucked, key-ring flung up on its chain, moustache blown back; the spiked ID-card block directly beneath him; three cyan coins ahead; sky at full brightness.
beats.impact: Continuous side-scroll, he lands with a two-frame squash-and-stretch and keeps running. The chiptune bed starts on frame one with a rising jump blip. Code drops the label plate TENANT VERIFICATION above the block on frame one and the RentOK wordmark into the HUD band as the score plate. No hold: the film is moving from its first frame.

beats.title: Rent runs away
beats.framing: The owner lands and runs right. Ahead, five cyan coins sprout tiny pixel legs and sprint away from him along the bricks; one hops clean over his head. He lunges and grabs only air. Sky one shade dimmer than beat 1. Camera keeps pace to the right.
beats.first_frame: The owner just landed, one foot forward, both arms out; five cyan coins with legs mid-stride on the ground ahead, small dust puffs behind each.
beats.impact: Comic fast-loop run cycle on the coins; each escaping coin gives a short descending boop. Label COLLECTING RENT sits over the coins. The cut lands on his failed grab: the miss is the reason to leave.

beats.title: The door slams
beats.framing: A brown pixel hostel door with a blank brass plate stands on the bricks. A thin tenant sprite with a backpack, seen from behind, steps through it carrying a sack of cyan coins; the door slams shut in a puff of pixel dust. The owner arrives at speed from the left, runs into the shut door and bounces back onto his rear. Camera stops with the door at centre. Sky dimmer again, first orange in it.
beats.first_frame: The door ajar with the backpacked tenant halfway through, coin sack under his arm; the owner mid-run two body lengths to the left.
beats.impact: The slam is a hard low chiptune thud with a one-frame screen shake; the owner sits stunned with three pixel stars circling his head; one HUD heart turns grey (code). Label LEFT WITHOUT PAYING over the door. Hold half a second on the sitting owner; his getting up motivates the cut.

beats.title: Paper wall, complaint rain
beats.feeling: Crushed: too many problems arriving at once.
beats.framing: The owner runs into a wall of pixel ledgers and loose receipts taller than the frame, blocking the way right. From the top of frame, angry red pixel drops shaped like a dripping tap, a cracked bulb and a snapped fan blade rain down. One lands on him and flattens him into a pancake sprite on the bricks. Sky at dusk-dark, the darkest of the film. Camera static.
beats.first_frame: The owner skidding to a halt, heels dug in, before the paper wall; the first red drops just entering the top of frame; the last HUD heart blinking (code).
beats.impact: Each drop falls with a descending blip; the flatten lands on a comic splat chord; the music bed drops to a single low pulse. Labels NO RECONCILIATION on the wall and COMPLAINTS beside the drops. Hold 0.7 s on the flat owner, one eye blinking, before anything else happens.

beats.title: The cheat code
beats.feeling: Relief flipping into delight: there is a way through.
beats.framing: The rentok_phone item drops from the top of frame and lands upright beside the flattened owner, its blue screen glowing. He peels himself up and taps it. Code types the cheat-code strip INSTALL and RENTOK APP letter by letter across the middle of the frame. The phone screen flashes white, a cyan burst fills the frame, and the owner becomes owner_powered: kurta blue, cyan glow outline, right forearm now a cyan arm-cannon. He raises the phone high. The sky snaps back to full brightness. The camera pushes in slightly on the transformation, the film's only push.
beats.first_frame: The phone item hanging mid-air just above the flattened owner, screen glowing blue with cyan sparkles around it; the world still dusk-dark; the red drops frozen in the top of frame.
beats.impact: The music stops for a beat. A dry keyboard tick for every letter of the cheat code as it types. Then an ascending power-up arpeggio as he transforms, and the bed returns at double tempo. Hold 0.5 s on the raised phone, wordmark composited onto its screen, before the cut.

beats.title: Immune run, part one
beats.feeling: Power: nothing can touch him now.
beats.framing: The powered owner sprints right at double speed, cannon raised, a trail of cyan glow behind him. The spiked ID-card block reappears ahead; one cyan check-mark bolt and it shatters into cyan sparkles. Next the runaway coins with legs come at him; a bolt and they flip, run back and pour into his kurta pocket. Fast side-scroll, camera glued to him.
beats.first_frame: The powered owner in full sprint pose, cannon aimed right, the first check-mark bolt just leaving the barrel, the ID-card block one body length ahead.
beats.impact: Each bolt is a bright pew chirp, each hit a coin chime landing on the beat. Code swaps the label above the block to DIGITAL KYC with its check-mark as it shatters, and the coins' label to AUTOPAY as they pour in. No holds anywhere in this beat.

beats.title: Immune run, part two
beats.feeling: Glee: the whole backlog cleared in one breath.
beats.framing: Same sprint, same direction. The slammed door ahead: a bolt and it swings open, a sack of cyan coins sliding out to his feet. The paper wall beyond: a bolt and every sheet folds into one neat glowing cyan tablet that shrinks into his pocket. The red drops rain again: a bolt each turns them into cyan check-marks that drift upward and fade. The cyan edge of a flagpole enters at frame right as the last drop clears.
beats.first_frame: The powered owner sprinting, the closed door ahead and the paper wall behind it, the first red drop entering the top of frame.
beats.impact: Three hits in rhythm with the music; the sky brightens a step with each. Code swaps labels to DUES TRACKED LIVE at the door, ONE DASHBOARD at the wall, COMPLAINT TICKETS at the drops, each with its check-mark. The frame goes clean and quiet for half a beat as the flagpole edge appears; that quiet is the cut.

beats.title: The flag
beats.framing: A tall cyan flagpole on a blue brick step at centre. The powered owner leaps, catches the pole at the top and slides down it as a cyan flag (wordmark composited by code) runs up. Behind, a three-storey pixel PG building with every window lit warm yellow and a small cyan check-mark over each window. On the ground below, five small grey heaps where the obstacles were. Sky at its brightest. Camera fully static for the whole beat, the only static shot in the film.
beats.first_frame: The owner at the top of the pole, one hand gripping it, the other holding the glowing phone high; the flag at the base; every window of the building lit; the five grey heaps on the bricks.
beats.impact: Level-clear fanfare. He slides down over one second, the flag runs up, he lands, turns to camera and raises the phone again; hold 1.5 s on that pose to the end of the beat. Tonal separation is the picture: dark-outlined sprite against pale sky, warm windows against the blue ground.

beats.title: Brand close (code-composed)
beats.feeling: Certainty: you know exactly what to do next.
beats.framing: Flat blue #0038FF field edge to edge. The RentOK wordmark (Rent white, Ok cyan) centred at 40 percent height, assembling pixel by pixel. Below it INSTALL over RENTOK APP in the white pixel font. RENTOK.COM along the bottom. The powered owner sprite, cut from the beat 8 still, stands small at bottom-left on one row of bricks holding the phone up.
beats.first_frame: The blue field with the wordmark halfway assembled and the owner sprite already in place; the CTA lines not yet on.
beats.impact: The bed resolves to a two-note chiptune sting exactly as the last pixel of the wordmark lands; INSTALL and RENTOK APP pop in on the sting; RENTOK.COM fades in a half-second later; then silence and hold to the end.

sources.s_install: brief exact_text_strings, value INSTALL (listed twice: cheat-code strip and close card)
sources.s_app: brief exact_text_strings, value RENTOK APP (listed twice: cheat-code strip and close card)
sources.s_left: brief exact_text_strings, value LEFT WITHOUT PAYING
sources.s_dues: brief exact_text_strings, value ✓ DUES TRACKED LIVE

hud_wordmark.why: The rentok_wordmark reference asset (not a string) sits in the dark HUD band top-left as the score plate for the whole game, so the brand is on screen from frame one and recurs continuously; identity invariants kept exactly (Rent white, Ok cyan #03FFF1, blue #0038FF ground).

label_verify.why: Names the first obstacle the instant it appears; white pixel font on a black plate, contrast well above 4.5:1 over the busy game frame.

label_rent.why: Names the running coins so the gag reads in a muted feed.

label_left.why: Placed on the slam, not before it, so the door slamming is the surprise and the label is the explanation.

label_recon_complaints.why: Two obstacles share one beat; the wall label sits on the wall, the complaints label beside the falling drops, never overlapping the owner.

cheat_code_strip.why: The ask carried as a scene from the story: a cheat code typed letter by letter across the middle of the frame on a black plate, INSTALL on the first line, RENTOK APP on the second; first, softer call to action.

solve_kyc.why: Replaces the verification label as the block shatters: each problem label is answered by its check-marked feature, in the same slot, so the swap itself is the message.

solve_autopay.why: Replaces the rent label as the coins pour into his pocket.

solve_dues.why: Replaces the door label as it swings open.

solve_dashboard.why: Replaces the reconciliation label as the papers fold into one tablet.

solve_tickets.why: Replaces the complaints label as the drops turn to check-marks.

flag_wordmark.why: The rentok_wordmark asset composited onto the cyan flag as it runs up the pole: the brand in context as the goal of the level.

close_card.why: The direct ask, most direct at the end: wordmark, INSTALL, RENTOK APP, RENTOK.COM on the flat blue field; white on #0038FF clears 4.5:1 for the CTA lines.

mandatory.customer_words: I want to make a video for RentOK ... Brand and product source: Official RentOK website, https://rentok.com
mandatory.realisation: RentOK wordmark in the HUD from 0 s, on the phone screen at 12 s, on the flag at 23 s and centred on the close card; identity invariants (Rent white, Ok cyan #03FFF1, blue #0038FF ground) drive the whole palette: blue bricks, cyan coins, cyan power-up.

mandatory.customer_words: The video has a Mario game ... An original Mario-inspired game, rather than an exact reproduction of Nintendo's character, artwork, music or game assets
mandatory.realisation: Side-scrolling 16-bit platformer grammar (jump, bricks, coins, item drop, power-up, flagpole, level-clear) with wholly original sprites, world and chiptune; the negative line bans every recognisable Nintendo asset.

mandatory.customer_words: The player is basically a PG owner
mandatory.realisation: The playable sprite is a moustached PG owner in a kurta with a ring of keys on his belt, present in every beat.
Beat 1: a spiked block of ID cards with a padlock he must jump; beat 6: shattered by a check-mark bolt, label becomes ✓ DIGITAL KYC.
Beat 2: cyan coins grow legs and run away from him; beat 6: they turn back and pour into his pocket, label ✓ AUTOPAY.
Beat 3: a backpacked tenant carries a coin sack out and the door slams in his face, costing a heart; beat 7: the door swings open and the sack slides out to him, label ✓ DUES TRACKED LIVE.
Beat 4: a wall of ledgers and receipts blocks the level; beat 7: it folds into one glowing tablet, label ✓ ONE DASHBOARD.
Beat 4: red drops (tap, bulb, fan blade) rain down and flatten him; beat 7: each becomes a check-mark that floats away, label ✓ COMPLAINT TICKETS.

mandatory.customer_words: The game also introduces a cheat code — install RentOK app
mandatory.realisation: Beat 5: a phone item drops in, he taps it, and INSTALL / RENTOK APP types itself across the frame like a cheat code; repeated on the close card.

mandatory.customer_words: Once it is done, Mario gets a gun sort of power/immunity ... preserving the requested game-style power/immunity mechanic
mandatory.realisation: Beat 5: transformation to the powered form with a cyan arm-cannon firing check-mark bolts and a glow outline; beats 6 and 7: nothing touches him, every obstacle is cleared by a bolt.

mandatory.customer_words: It runs and kills all the obstacles and gets the flag
mandatory.realisation: Beats 6 and 7: a continuous left-to-right sprint clearing all five obstacles in order; beat 8: he takes the flagpole with the level-clear fanfare and the obstacles lie as heaps below.

mandatory.customer_words: Platforms: Instagram Reels / Facebook and YouTube Shorts
mandatory.realisation: 9:16 portrait, labels and CTA inside the safe area above the platform UI, muted-feed test passes because every problem and solution is labelled on screen.
Nine contiguous beats, 0 to 30 s, last t_out = 30.

mandatory.customer_words: exact_text_strings (INSTALL, RENTOK APP, TENANT VERIFICATION, COLLECTING RENT, LEFT WITHOUT PAYING, NO RECONCILIATION, COMPLAINTS, the five ✓ lines, RENTOK.COM)
mandatory.realisation: All thirteen distinct strings placed verbatim by code as labels, cheat-code strip and close card; INSTALL and RENTOK APP appear twice as listed.

mandatory.customer_words: motion: audio true; Visual treatment and power-up design delegated to the creative system
mandatory.realisation: Native audio with an original chiptune bed and sound effects doing the work of speech; visual treatment is original 16-bit pixel art in the brand palette; the power-up is a cyan check-mark arm-cannon plus glow immunity.

brand_timeline.in_context: Wordmark as the HUD score plate from 0 s to 27 s; blue #0038FF ground and cyan #03FFF1 coins carry the palette in every beat; the phone item with the wordmark on its screen at 12 to 15 s; the wordmark on the flag at 23 to 27 s; full wordmark and URL on the close card at 27 to 30 s.
brand_timeline.spoken: none (no voice-over; the two-note chiptune sting at 27 s is the brand's audio mark)

last_frame: Flat blue #0038FF field, RentOK wordmark centred (Rent white, Ok cyan), INSTALL over RENTOK APP beneath it in white pixel type, RENTOK.COM along the bottom, the powered owner sprite small at bottom-left on a single brick row holding the glowing phone up.
